allocator.description: allocates a new dynamically-sized memory block and returns a pointer to it, or NULL on failure

deallocator.description: releases an object and the resources owned by it; the pointer must not be used afterwards

buffer_copy.description: copies bytes from a source buffer into a destination buffer

init.description: initializes an object or handler structure to a default state

parser_input.description: parses an in-memory document, typically taking a parser context and a character buffer
